criteria.name: Search bar filters tasks by title (case-insensitive)
criteria.notes: Title substring matching works via searchQuery state with toLowerCase() comparison.

criteria.name: Search bar filters tasks by description
criteria.notes: Description is included in the filter predicate alongside title.

criteria.name: Clear button resets search
criteria.notes: × button sets searchQuery to empty string. Only visible when searchQuery is non-empty.

criteria.name: Phase filter multi-select dropdown
criteria.notes: Set<string> tracks selected phases. Checkboxes for all 9 COLUMNS with Clear button.

criteria.name: Source filter dropdown
criteria.notes: Filters by task.source (ideation/competitor-analysis) or shows all. Active indicator badge.

criteria.name: Sort dropdown with all 4 options
criteria.notes: Newest first, Oldest first, A→Z, Z→A all work via createdAt.localeCompare and title.localeCompare.

criteria.name: Filters stack together
criteria.notes: Search + phase + source + sort all applied in a single processedTasks() pipeline.

criteria.name: Reset button clears all filters
criteria.notes: Visible when hasActiveFilters is true. Resets searchQuery, phaseFilter, sourceFilter, sortBy.

criteria.name: Dark theme styling matches existing design
criteria.notes: Uses same bg-[#1a1f2e], border-[#334155], text-slate colors as the rest of the app.

criteria.name: All 106 unit tests still pass
criteria.notes: No regressions. vitest run shows 106/106 passed.

criteria.name: Performance: processedTasks() called once, not per-column
criteria.notes: Wrapped in IIFE to call once, then destructure into columns.
